# Elsevier Generic Artwork

`elsevier-generic@2026.08.0` · profile digest `0b76724e2c05841546642471c0868fca668ac603032c37b56494bce375f57410`

Generic Elsevier artwork sizing and export guidance.

## Rules

| Rule ID | Strength | Phases | Probe | Assertion |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `figure.width.minimal` | required | live, file | `artifact.width_mm` | approx `30` mm |
| `figure.width.single` | required | live, file | `artifact.width_mm` | approx `90` mm |
| `figure.width.one-and-half` | required | live, file | `artifact.width_mm` | approx `140` mm |
| `figure.width.double` | required | live, file | `artifact.width_mm` | approx `190` mm |
| `font.family` | recommended | live | `font.families.effective` | subset `Arial, Helvetica, Courier, Times, Times New Roman, sans-serif, serif` |
| `font.size.target` | inferred | live | `font.size.max_pt` | eq `8` pt |
| `line.width.min` | recommended | live | `line.width.min_pt` | gte `0.25` pt |
| `export.formats.vector` | recommended | file | `artifact.format` | in `pdf, eps` |
| `export.formats.halftone` | recommended | file | `artifact.format` | in `tiff, jpeg` |
| `export.formats.combination` | recommended | file | `artifact.format` | in `tiff, pdf, eps` |
| `export.formats.line_art` | recommended | file | `artifact.format` | in `eps, pdf, tiff` |
| `export.min_dpi.halftone` | required | file | `artifact.dpi` | gte `300` dpi |
| `export.min_dpi.combination` | required | file | `artifact.dpi` | gte `500` dpi |
| `export.min_dpi.line_art` | required | file | `artifact.dpi` | gte `1000` dpi |
